title: Balanced Parenthesis Builder
commonMistakes: Adding a closing parenthesis when no unmatched opening parenthesis exists
Allowing more than n opening parentheses
Generating duplicates and forgetting to deduplicate
Returning the strings in recursion-dependent order instead of lexical order
Forgetting that n = 0 produces the empty string
followUps: Can you generate the strings directly in lexicographic order without sorting?
How does the count of results grow with n?
How would you generate strings with three bracket types that must nest correctly?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
